title: Detect and capture source regions

repository_anchor.rule: Re-measure HEAD, residue, processes, clocks, and private-manifest hash immediately before execution. Any drift produces GROUND-DRIFT and a revised unsigned packet.

objective: Implement an out-of-band, CPU-only, report-only source-page renderer and deterministic region-capture instrument over calibration cases only.
entry_requirements: The user signs this exact VW-E2-R1 packet.
The VW-E1 contract, schemas, corpus manifest, and packet hashes still match.
The three held-out cases remain unopened by the builder.
At least 8 GiB scratch free space is measured.
No live converter, model, browser, or GPU process is started by this event.

write_scope.single_writer: root integrator or one designated builder; never concurrent file writers
allowed_updates: the VW-E2 exit receipt and observability artifact
private_runtime_outputs: an event-scoped temporary directory for renders and tiles

read_scope.operational_roots: Read-only source PDFs, raw Markdown, manifests, and assets named by the private corpus manifest.

frozen_configuration.coordinate_system: canonical PDF points plus normalized page fractions
frozen_configuration.page_numbering: source pages 1-based; asset filename page IDs retained separately as 0-based
frozen_configuration.boundary_rule: Any candidate touching an internal tile edge is re-centered in a larger crop or becomes VW-TILE-GAP/UNREAD.
frozen_configuration.fusion_rule: Fuse by containment, intersection, and stroke connectivity after mapping every proposal to page coordinates.

outputs: A deterministic page/render/tile/region metadata report conforming to the VW-E1 identity and reason-code contract.
Hash-bound crop metadata; raw full-page renders, tiles, crops, and extracted text remain ephemeral and are deleted at event close.
Per-case timing, peak RSS, scratch peak, page-readability, tile-union, region-class, conflict, and UNREAD receipts.
A schema-conforming VW-E2 exit receipt with next_event_authority=UNSIGNED.

unit_and_property: Half-open tile arithmetic over odd and even page dimensions.
The union of base tiles covers every valid rendered page pixel or the page is UNREAD.
Non-zero CropBox offset and MediaBox/CropBox distinction.
Coordinate round-trip between pixel, normalized, and PDF-point spaces.
integration: Synthetic PDF to render to tiles/regions to report twice with byte-identical canonical output.
Before/after protected-tree digest proves source PDF, bundle, Markdown, assets, and manifest remained identical.
Calibration case source SHA and raw-Markdown/asset inventory hashes are reverified.
negative_controls: A one-pixel object crossing a four-tile corner.
Blank page, corrupt/unrenderable page, and full-page scan.
Zero-area connectors and a table-like technical drawing.
Gross out-of-range and plausible in-range poisoned page maps.
Forced render failure and forced truncation/edge failure.
The same-check control deliberately removes one pixel from the declared tile union and must fail.

exit_criteria: Every declared calibration page is accounted for as measured or reason-coded UNREAD.
For readable pages, covered_valid_pixels / valid_page_pixels equals 1.0 under the frozen base-tile configuration.
All geometry, identity, page-map, render-failure, and same-check negative controls bite.
No model, network, GPU, bundle, gate, repair, ship, publication, vault, or session-clock effect occurs.
An independent verifier reruns a consequential sample and the planted negative control.
Ephemeral scratch is removed and residue/process/port/GPU census is reported.
The complete receipt sets next_event_authority to UNSIGNED and agent progression stops.
effect_boundary: New out-of-band report-only detector files and local metadata only. Default converter, analyst, Repair Bench, bundles, manifests, assets, shipping, gates, and vault behavior remain unchanged.
user_experience: After completion, the user receives an inspectable calibration report of page regions and explicit UNREADs. No converted document or visible product behavior changes.
